@graph.name: Wealthfront Automated Investing API
@graph.description: Internal REST API powering Wealthfront's automated portfolio management service. Supports account creation, portfolio configuration, risk assessment, automated rebalancing, and tax-loss harvesting for diversified index fund portfolios.

@graph.name: Wealthfront Tax Optimization API
@graph.description: Automated tax optimization service providing daily tax-loss harvesting, direct indexing at the stock level for accounts over $100,000, and Smart Beta factor weighting for accounts over $500,000.

@graph.name: Wealthfront Cash Account API
@graph.description: High-yield cash management account API supporting deposits, withdrawals, transfers, bill pay, and debit card management. Offers 3.30% base APY with FDIC insurance up to $8 million through deposits swept across up to 32 program banks.

@graph.name: Wealthfront Account Linking API
@graph.description: External account linking and data aggregation platform that connects Wealthfront with third-party financial institutions via vendors such as Plaid and Finicity. Handles authentication on behalf of clients and ingestion of external account data.

@graph.name: Wealthfront Financial Planning API (Path)
@graph.description: Financial planning and retirement projection API powering Wealthfront's Path product. Aggregates linked external accounts, models retirement scenarios, and provides personalized projections for goals including home purchase, college savings, and retirement.
